newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Jamaica beauty queen charged with murder.
newsitem.headline: Jamaica beauty queen charged with murder.

text.p: A reigning beauty queen and two other people including an American have been arrested and charged with the slaying of a taxi operator, Jamaica police said on Tuesday.

Theresa Josephs, 21, the current Miss City of Montego Bay, along with businessman Richard Solomon, 27, also of Montego Bay and 24 year-old U.S. citizen Anthony Taylor, 24, were formally charged Monday in connection with the crime.
The group was accused of killing taxi operator Kevin Cummings, 32, whose decomposing body was found near Montego Bay on April 4 with a bullet wound to the forehead.

Josephs and Taylor were detained Thursday at Montego Bay's international airport while preparing to board a flight for New York. Solomon was arrested Friday after a search of his house uncovered a .22 revolver and five rounds of ammunition. The police have seized the weapon for ballistics tests.
Police said the motive for the killing was not yet known. Details of the American involved were not available.
